approve.title: Approve this event?
approve.text: Approving cannot be undone from here (an approved event can only be cancelled).

points.public: The event goes on the public pages and tickets go on sale in their sales window.
points.seats: The seats are created from the venue layout.

reject.title: Reject this event?
reject.text: The organizer sees your reason, can fix the event and submit it again.
reject.reasonHint: Required. Up to 500 characters. The organizer sees it.
reject.reasonRequired: A reason is required to reject the event.

cancel.title: Cancel this event?
cancel.refundText: All paid orders of this event are refunded in full automatically. This can’t be undone.

points.closed: The event is closed for good. It leaves the public pages and its sales stop.
points.refunds: Every paid order is refunded in full, in batches. The normal refund deadline does not apply.
points.used: Tickets that were already checked in are refunded too.
points.notices: Each buyer gets a “refund completed” notification and the organizer gets a summary.
points.retry: An order that fails to refund stays paid. After cancelling you can run the refunds again from this page.
points.stock: Seats and tickets do not go back on sale.

cancel.reasonHint: Required. Up to 500 characters. It is saved with the event.
cancel.reasonRequired: A reason is required to cancel the event.

suspend.reasonRequired: A reason is required to suspend an organizer.

commission.title: Commission
commission.subtitle: The platform keeps a percentage of each paid order. It is taken from the organizer’s share, not added for the buyer.

tiers.note: The rate is set when an order is paid and saved on that order, so changing it never changes past orders. A count of exactly 5 or 20 already gets the lower rate.

commission.overrideExpired: An earlier override of {{rate}}% has ended.

notice.cleared: {{name}}’s {{previous}}% override was cleared. They now pay the automatic {{rate}}%.

empty.text: Approved organizers will appear here with their commission rate.

dialog.rateHint: A number from 0 to 100, for example 5 or 7.5.
dialog.endHint: The override ends at the end of this day (Seoul time). Leave it empty for no end date.
dialog.reasonHint: Required. Up to 500 characters. The organizer is notified with this reason.
dialog.confirmText: Orders paid from now on use this rate instead of the tier rate. Past orders keep the rate they were paid with.

errors.rate_range: The rate must be a number from 0 to 100.

clear.text: From now on, paid orders use the automatic tier rate. Past orders keep the rate they were paid with. This is recorded in the audit log.
